title: The Apothecary Diaries Director Breaks Silence on Biggest Change in Season 3
content: The Apothecary Diaries is taking all the spotlight this Fall 2026 anime season with its exciting Season 3. There’s no denying it’s one of the biggest shows of the 2020s, not only within the Seinen demographic but also compared to all the major genres as well.
author: ComicBook

title: Scriptwriter Toyoto Kogisu Dies at 69
content: Kogisu contributed as a writer for several episodes of the Detective Conan anime between 2000-2018, including the 733rd episode "The Wedding Reception and the Two Gunshots" (pictured right). He has also written scripts for live-action series such as Taiyō ni Hoero!
author: ANN

title: Tim Burton’s Failed Sci-Fi Movie From the ’90s Could Have Been a Game Changer for Manga
content: Tim Burton has made a career out of making weirdos look cool. Beetlejuice is a walking bad decision. Edward Scissorhands has blenders for hands. Sweeney Todd’s demon barber speaks for itself.
author: ComicBook

title: Shigeru Miyamoto Becomes 1st Game Creator to be Honored With Japan's Order of Culture Award
content: At a press conference at Nintendo in Kyoto, Miyamoto stated that as games are created by not just one person, but by many collaborating together, he honors their work with this award. The Emperor will present Miyamoto with the award on November 3, Japan's Culture Day.
author: ANN

title: Seven Seas Licenses Secret Relationships Webtoon for Print Release in August 2027
content: Seven Seas Entertainment announced on October 22 that it has licensed the Secret Relationships webtoon for English print release. The boys-love office romance webtoon has also been adapted into a live-action series. The story follows Daon, who grew up in poverty and works hard to secure his financial future.
author: ANN

title: Korean-Animated Film Your Letter Begins Streaming on Crunchyroll
content: The Korean-animated film Your Letter , based on Hyeon A Cho 's webtoon of the same name, began streaming on Crunchyroll on October 19. The film is available in Korean with subtitles in English and several other languages. Fans can watch it here .
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball GT Gave Fans One Of The Coolest Villains (& They Need to Be Made Canon)
content: The recent Dragon Ball canonization of fan-favorite characters and power levels needs to continue by adding in Dragon Ball GT ‘s favorite and only Tuffle, Baby. Dragon Ball GT didn’t deliver the same iconic villains as Frieza, Cell and Buu.
author: ComicBook

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Original Score and Soundtrack Albums Released
content: CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 2 has released two official music albums following the anime’s Netflix debut on October 20, including an original score by Tsuneo Imahori and a separate soundtrack featuring songs from Rico Nasty, Corbin, DOUDOU, BIJI and more. The songs are now available on major music streaming platforms .
author: Anime Corner

title: Manhwa-Based Live-Action Series The Blue Road Releases Teaser Trailer Ahead of November 20 Premiere

title: Takopi’s Original Sin Movie Reveals Main Trailer With New Scenes, Key Visual and Tele Theme Song
content: Takopi’s Original Sin -Thank You, See You Tomorrow- movie revealed a new key visual and main trailer ahead of its November 27, 2026 release in Japan. The anime originally ran from June 28 to August 1. It swept the weekly rankings every week during its run, taking five wins.
